summary:
Fixed in Debian trixie-security 6.0-29+deb13u1 (DSA-6440-1): heap OOB read
in the EF_IZUNIX3 extra-field handler. Source is pulled via apt-source
ignoreVersion; metadata.version stays at 6.0-29 so the +eN label remains
dpkg-monotonic above the previously published 6.0-29+e3.
